title: self escaping from an iteration block of a constructor that then fails stays unfinished
purpose: The object built for the first self value inside map escapes into an Atomic; the constructor throws, and calling an action on the escaped value fails at run time (#271).

failure.justification: The constructor failed after its receiver escaped into an Atomic; the escaped value never completes construction, and only execution can see it.

provenance.expected_basis: Owner decision on #279: early self is built once, at a point that dominates the rest of the constructor, keeping bound fields, later obj.init, the $pending lifecycle (#271), identity and cyclic equality (#278).
